q0AnchorReason: Exact integers and highest-weight combinatorics only. No substrate modulus, no q, no float; the import cone is json/os/sys/time/fractions/itertools. Nothing here can depend on the q0 anchor.

data.verdict: S_3 on three quaternionic lines yields Sp(1)^3 : S_3, NOT SU(3). Scope-(b) for that claim.

assertions.name: bring_cone_m_is_1
assertions.note: the Bring cone C(B) is real-4-dimensional: m = 1, where the tetraplectic condition is vacuous (qou-8p1g finding 1)

assertions.name: sp3_over_sp1_cubed_has_m_3
assertions.note: dim = 21 - 9 = 12 = 4*3, so m = 3 >= 2: the vacuity IS escaped

assertions.name: sp3_tangent_is_three_quaternionic_lines
assertions.note: tangent = H_12 + H_13 + H_23, each acted on by (q_i, q_j) via x -> q_i x conj(q_j)

assertions.name: s3_acts_faithfully_on_the_three_lines
assertions.note: all 6 permutations of {1,2,3} induce distinct permutations of {12, 13, 23}: the action on the lines is faithful

assertions.name: dim_su3_exceeds_dim_su2
assertions.note: dim su(3) = 8 > 3 = dim su(2), so no injection into a single factor

assertions.name: su3_is_simple
assertions.note: A_2 is an irreducible root system, so su(3) is simple; this is the premise that makes the projection argument work

assertions.name: naive_dim_count_is_insufficient
assertions.note: dim su(2)^3 = 9 > 8 = dim su(3): a dimension count on the PRODUCT permits an embedding. Simplicity, not dimension, is what excludes it

assertions.name: su3_min_nontrivial_real_irrep_dim
assertions.note: the 3 is of complex type, so its realification is 6-dimensional; the adjoint 8 is the smallest of real type

assertions.name: su3_has_no_real_irrep_of_dim_2_3_4_5
assertions.note: so SU(3) cannot act nontrivially on one quaternionic line H = R^4

assertions.name: su3_embeds_in_sp_n_iff_n_at_least_3
assertions.note: SU(3) < U(3) < Sp(3) is the standard chain

assertions.name: smallest_flag_with_both_s3_and_su3_available
assertions.note: Sp(9)/Sp(3)^3 -- and even there the SU(3) is a chosen reduction of one factor, not something the tetraplectic condition supplies

assertions.name: hp3_tangent_as_su3_is_3_plus_3bar
assertions.note: H^3 = C^3 + C^3 j = 3 + conj(3) as a complex SU(3)-rep, real dimension 12 = the tangent space; available by REDUCTION only

assertions.name: s_n_on_lines_admits_no_connected_enhancement
assertions.note: a continuous homomorphism from a connected group to a finite group is constant, so the permutation of the lines can never carry gauge bosons

assertions.name: verdict_s3_yields_sp1_cubed_semidirect_s3_not_su3
assertions.note: checks 3 and 4 together: SU(3) -> Sp(1)^3 : S_3 lands in the identity component Sp(1)^3 by connectedness, and every such map is zero

assertions.name: any_su3_preserving_the_three_lines_is_trivial
assertions.note: connectedness kills the permutation part, and SU(3) has no nontrivial real representation of dimension 4, so nothing is left -- this does not depend on naming Sp(1)^3 : S_3 as the structure group
